# Avatar

A person or an agent shown as a picture, initials or an icon. The picture wins when it loads, then the initials, then the icon, then a plain person glyph.

Also asked as: user photo, initials, profile image, user picture, tutor photo, student photo.

**Import:** `import { Avatar } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/Avatar/Avatar.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/Avatar/Avatar.stories.jsx` — Initials, Sizes, DefaultSize, Shapes, Fallbacks, Colors, Status, Naming, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, Disabled

## Usage

Use `Avatar` wherever a person or an agent is named in a row, a thread or a
list of attendees. Use `AvatarGroup` for a short set of people that would crowd
a line: the attendees of a session, the members of a team.

Use `Tile` for a school, a tool or a lesson: a square picture of a thing, not
a face. The signed-in person is shown by the Sidebar's account row, with the
name and role beside the avatar.

## Best practices

### Circle for people, square for teams and agents. {#circle-for-people-square-for-teams-and-agents}

Keep one shape per kind within a list, so the shape tells a person from an
agent at a glance.

Do: A circle for a person, a square for an agent.
Don't: A person in a square and an agent in a circle.

### Keep the name beside bare initials. {#keep-the-name-beside-bare-initials}

Two people can share initials. The name is what tells them apart, so drop it
only where the person is named nearby.

### Let the group set the size. {#let-the-group-set-the-size}

`AvatarGroup` passes its `size` and `shape` to every avatar, so the row stays
even.

```jsx
<AvatarGroup label="Session attendees" max={5}>
    {people.map((p) => <Avatar key={p.id} name={p.name} src={p.photo} />)}
</AvatarGroup>
```

### A color is a category, not a status. {#a-color-is-a-category-not-a-status}

Keep one color per kind of person, or leave avatars blue. Green, yellow and red belong to the presence dot, so a green avatar reads as "online".

Do: One color for all people, or one per kind.
Don't: Green and yellow read as online and away.

### Show presence only where it helps. {#show-presence-only-where-it-helps}

Use the dot in a list a person scans for who is around. Leave it off a byline or a comment, where presence is not the question.

Do: The dot in a list that is scanned for who is around.
Don't: A dot on a tiny byline, where presence is not the question.

## Accessibility

- **Decorative by default.** An avatar with no `name` or `label` is hidden from
  assistive technology (`aria-hidden="true"`), for use beside a name that
  already says who it is.
- **A name makes it one image.** With a `name` or `label` it becomes
  `role="img"` with that name. A `status` is added to the name ("Jane Park,
  online"), since the dot's color alone says nothing to a screen reader.
- **The group is a named group.** Give `AvatarGroup` a `label`. The `+n` is a
  button named by its count ("+3, 3 more people"); it opens a menu of the
  hidden people by name, reached with Tab and closed with Escape.
- **Not a control.** An avatar has no hover or focus state of its own. To make
  one clickable, wrap it in a button or link that carries the name.

## Related

- For the signed-in person, with a name and a role, use the Sidebar's account row.
- For a school, a tool or a lesson in a square, use `Tile`.
- For a role or state beside a name, use `Status`.

Same group: `AiIcon` · `AvatarGroup` · `Icon` · `Illustration` · `Image` · `Object` · `Tile`

## Parts

1. **Face.** The picture when it loads; otherwise the initials, then the icon, then a plain person glyph.
2. **Frame.** A circle for a person; a square for a team or an agent, with a radius of a quarter of its size.
3. **Presence dot.** Optional, a quarter of the avatar's size at the bottom right, ringed in the surface color.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The only state. The ground and ink come from the Tag color set; a picture covers them. |
| Hovered, pressed | None. An avatar is a picture, not a control; wrap it in a button or link for a click. |
| Focused | None. It is not in the tab order. |
| Disabled | None. A person is never dimmed; a state for the account belongs in the name or the page. |
| Presence | The dot takes the success, warning, danger or neutral bold fill for online, away, busy and offline. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Size | `--image-xxs` to `--image-lg` for 16 to 40; 96 and 128 are built from the large spacing primitives. |
| Ground and ink | `--ds-background-accent-blue-subtler` and `--ds-text-accent-blue` for blue, and the same pair for each other Tag color. |
| Radius | `--radius-full` for a circle; a quarter of the size for a square. |
| Presence dot | `--ds-background-success-bold`, `-warning-bold`, `-danger-bold`, `-neutral-bold`; ring `--ds-surface`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use the person's full name: "Jane Park". | Initials alone, or a nickname, where a full name is known. |
| Name an agent by its job: "Study bot". | A generic "Bot" or "AI". |
| Write a `label` that says who or what it is. | "Avatar" or "Profile picture", which says nothing about whom. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `src` | string | — | The picture's URL. If it is missing or fails to load, the initials show. |
| `name` | string | — | The person's or agent's name. Gives the initials and, unless `label` is set, the accessible name. |
| `initials` | string | — | Overrides the initials taken from `name`. |
| `icon` | string or node | — | The fallback when there is no picture and no initials: a Font Awesome Free name (`robot`), a class list, or a node. Defaults to `user`. |
| `size` | enum | `32` | 16 to 40 follow the Media sizes; 96 and 128 are for profiles. |
| `shape` | enum | `'circle'` | `circle` for a person, `square` for a team or an agent. |
| `color` | enum | `'blue'` | The ground of the initials and icon, from the Tag color set. A picture covers it. |
| `status` | enum | — | A presence dot at the bottom right. It is said in the accessible name. |
| `label` | string | — | The accessible name when it should differ from `name`. Without a name or a label the avatar is decorative and hidden. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the avatar element beside the component's own. |
